bullets: US futures mixed into midterm elections: Nasdaq100 futures +0.44%, Dow futures -0.27%, S&P +3.5pts, after Monday's tech-led Nasdaq -1.07% drop.
Asia fell broadly (Kospi -2.7%, MSCI Asia ex-Japan -1.1%) on AI-spending jitters and caution ahead of US midterms and Treasury refunding.
Oil steadied near $105 Brent after an 8% overnight swing tied to Iran peace-talk headlines; yields little changed.
AI-earnings reaction split: Apple fell on slower growth, Palantir dropped 3% despite a beat, while IDEXX and Tempus AI jumped on strong prints.

DELL.why: Intel's Oct 29 warning on PC-market memory shortages and inventory cuts hit all PC/server OEMs; Dell fell with HP, HPE, Supermicro. No company-specific downgrades; Dell's AI-server backlog is a stated offset.
DELL.bull: AI-server backlog ($95B) and raised revenue guide cushion the PC-memory cost hit; no analyst downgrades.
DELL.bear: Rising memory costs squeeze thin PC margins sector-wide; full impact on Dell's earnings still unclear.

sources.title: Hardware Stock Selloff: Intel's Warning Triggers Sector-Wide Decline

HPE.why: Same Oct 29 Intel PC/memory-shortage warning dragged HPE down with Dell, HP and Supermicro. No company-specific analyst downgrades in the last 14 days; FY26 Q4 earnings webcast is scheduled but date is outside the 7-day window.
HPE.bull: Sector-wide hardware selloff, not HPE-specific; no downgrades and AI-server demand narrative intact.
HPE.bear: Memory-cost inflation and PC softness could pressure HPE margins alongside peers into earnings.

sources.title: Hardware Stock Selloff: Intel's Warning Triggers Sector-Wide Decline

HPQ.why: Fell with Dell/HPE/Supermicro on Intel's Oct 29 PC-slump/memory-shortage warning; HP is most consumer-PC exposed so hit hardest (-9%). No company-specific downgrades found. Next earnings ~Dec 1, outside the 7-day window.
HPQ.bull: Drop matches sector peers' declines exactly; no fundamental-specific bad news or downgrades found.
HPQ.bear: HP has the heaviest consumer-PC mix of the group, so memory-cost/demand hit could bite hardest.

sources.title: Hardware Stock Selloff: Intel's Warning Triggers Sector-Wide Decline
HP Inc. Earnings Preview: What to Expect

DINO.why: Q3 beat and a new permanent CEO, but refiners are being discounted industrywide on doubts that tight crack spreads/EPA waivers persist. Morgan Stanley raised to Overweight Nov 2; no negative company-specific downgrade found.
DINO.bull: Buybacks shrinking share count plus an Overweight upgrade (Morgan Stanley, Nov 2) argue the selloff is overdone.
DINO.bear: Market prices refining profits as temporary (tight supply, EPA waivers), capping multiple even after a beat.

sources.title: Is There Any Reason To Invest In HF Sinclair Stock?

ILMN.why: Despite raised 2026 guidance, analysts questioned whether NovaSeq X placements and clinical consumables growth are pulled-forward demand, and research markets stayed weak. Citigroup cut to Sell on Nov 2 (company-specific, aimed at ILMN alone).
ILMN.bull: Guidance was raised and JPMorgan/Evercore stayed bullish ($300/$275 PT), implying the selloff overshoots fundamentals.
ILMN.bear: Citi's Sell call and analyst doubt about demand durability (pull-forward, weak research market) are company-specific red flags.
flags: demand-durability doubts from own analyst Q&A

NTAP.why: Dropped with the Nasdaq (-2.86% day cited) on the same Intel-driven PC/hardware weakness as Dell/HP; a technical 'sell signal' was flagged but no company-specific analyst downgrade. Guggenheim merely initiated Neutral on Oct 26.
NTAP.bull: Decline tracks a broad hardware/Nasdaq selloff, not an NTAP-specific event; PEAK:AIO acquisition just closed.
NTAP.bear: A technical sell signal and no fresh bullish catalyst mean the stock could keep lagging the bounce.

sources.title: Stock Market Today: Nasdaq Slumps On Weak Intel Report; NetApp Gives Sell Signal

NTNX.why: Fell more than a broadly weak Nasdaq (-2.86% day); underperformance is attributed to elevated valuation (fwd P/E 30.6 vs 15.1 industry), not a fundamental or ratings hit. Guggenheim initiated Buy on Oct 26.
NTNX.bull: No negative company news; Guggenheim just initiated at Buy and VMware-replacement/hybrid-cloud demand story is intact.
NTNX.bear: Rich valuation vs. peers means NTNX can keep underperforming in any renewed tech-sector weakness.
flags: high relative valuation amplifies sector beta

sources.title: Nutanix (NTNX) Registers a Bigger Fall Than the Market: Important Facts to Note

OKTA.why: Drop is profit-taking after a run-up into S&P 500 inclusion, compounded by a software-sector 'AI disruption' narrative (agentic AI threatening identity-layer value) and macro oil/inflation jitters. No analyst downgrade found.
OKTA.bull: No fundamental damage; index-inclusion flows and no ratings cuts support a mechanical, not company, decline.
OKTA.bear: Agentic-AI disruption fears are hitting identity/software names broadly and could keep sentiment choppy.
OKTA.catalysts: Q3 FY27 results due Dec 1, 2026 - outside the 7-day window.

P.why: No clear sector or company damage story found for Everpure (formerly Pure Storage); coverage flags heavy insider selling (~$142M in 3 months) and routine valuation debate. No analyst downgrade in dd.moves.
P.bull: No downgrade or guidance cut found; drop looks like routine volatility/profit-taking, not damage.
P.bear: Heavy recent insider selling is a yellow flag even without a confirmed fundamental catalyst.
P.catalysts: Q3 FY27 earnings call Nov 18, 2026 - outside the 7-day window.
flags: cause of drop not clearly identified

sources.title: Everpure (NYSE:P) Stock Falls 6.9% - Time to Sell?

PLTR.why: Beat Q3 estimates with record US commercial revenue, yet fell ~3% amid a broad AI/tech selloff (Marvell, Lumentum) and stretched valuation (~150x+ earnings). Cantor cut to Neutral (company-specific) even as JPM, Oppenheimer and Rosenblatt stayed bullish.
PLTR.bull: Record commercial revenue growth and three bullish analyst actions (JPM, Oppenheimer, Rosenblatt) argue the beat was real.
PLTR.bear: Extreme valuation plus a company-specific Cantor downgrade to Neutral make this vulnerable to further de-rating.
flags: one company-specific downgrade amid mostly bullish reaction

AVTR.why: Q3 profit rebound ($203M vs prior-year loss) was overshadowed by management flagging margin headwinds from inflation/mix, European weakness, and conservative 0.75-1.25% organic growth guide. Barclays cut to Underweight (Oct 29, company-specific, fundamentals-based).
AVTR.bull: Baird raised to Outperform and profitability swung positive; growth could stabilize if margin pressure eases.
AVTR.bear: Barclays' Underweight call cites real margin/growth concerns flagged by management itself, not sentiment alone.

sources.title: Avantor (AVTR) Stock Drops As Q3 Earnings Rebound Meets Caution

CRM.why: Dipped (-1.3%) roughly in line with a broad Nasdaq selloff (-1.07%) and actually outperformed its tech sector's trailing-month decline (-9.88% sector vs -2.35% CRM). No negative company news; Buy rating and M&A activity continue.
CRM.bull: Underperforms its own sector's decline, trades below industry average P/E, and kept a Zacks Buy rank through the dip.
CRM.bear: A tech-wide de-rating could keep pressuring CRM even without company-specific bad news.

sources.title: Why Salesforce (CRM) Dipped More Than Broader Market Today

RMD.why: Beat EPS/revenue estimates but revenue growth slowed to 5.9% YoY, the weakest in five quarters, and RMD underperformed even its own healthcare sector. Canaccord cut to Hold same day (Nov 2, company-specific, growth-based).
RMD.bull: Still beat on both lines; RBC and Wells Fargo raised price targets (to $288/$250) after the print.
RMD.bear: Decelerating growth plus a same-day Canaccord downgrade to Hold signal a real, company-specific fundamental concern.

sources.title: What Sent ResMed Stock Lower?

PBF.why: Q3 beat big (adj. EPS $12.78) but shares barely moved as investors industrywide discount refiners' profits as cyclical/temporary (crack spreads, EPA waivers) - the same skepticism hitting peer DINO. Freedom Broker upgraded Nov 3; no negative downgrade.
PBF.bull: Earnings windfall and cash surge are real, plus a fresh upgrade (Freedom Broker, Nov 3) argue value isn't reflected.
PBF.bear: Market-wide doubt about refining-cycle durability (hedging volatility, temporary crack spreads) caps upside industrywide.

sources.title: PBF Energy (PBF) Stock Price Trails Its Q3 Earnings Windfall

PATH.why: No company-specific news, earnings, or downgrade found; fell more than the S&P 500 amid a broader 'AI magic is fading' narrative pressuring enterprise-software/AI names. Low rvol (0.78) supports no fresh company-specific trigger.
PATH.bull: No downgrade or bad news found; Zacks Buy rank and discount forward P/E vs industry remain intact.
PATH.bear: Belongs to a software/AI cohort losing favor on ROI doubts, which can keep dragging shares lower.
